text: Greater power for the Lord means grander estates, more slaves, and a position closer to the Witch King's Black Tower!
Tempered by years of thunderstorms, the poplar's spirit has a silvery form and extraordinary vitality, able to channel terrifying thunder that pierces through all armour and flesh
No matter when winter recedes, the unyielding birch spirit silently guards Athel Loren, awaiting the rebirth of dormant life from the ashes
Even the fiercest flames cannot destroy the ancient oak spirit, which has weathered every season, its duty ever reminded by the spectral souls within the ancient waystones
The willow's spirit is the herald of spring's return, the wellspring of life, and the resting place of departed souls, sustaining the Wood Elves and forest spirits against the direst of circumstances
The forest's malice gives birth to this vile creature with a heart of ice and stone, as graceful as a perfect dancer, yet its warped branches are most adept at piercing hearts from behind
